contribution.position: My position is unchanged. The perf report records 118s at peak load against a 60s budget, which is nearly double. The QA turn cites 45s from the same artifact, and that figure does not match what the report says, so the 'comfortably inside budget' reading is not supported. Last quarter's two sev2 incidents were both retry storms, and a run this far over budget can hit timeouts and trigger retries. The passing test suite (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) does not exercise load behavior, so it does not offset the perf result. The cost and runbook points are fair on their own axes, but they do not address retry amplification. What would settle this: retry and timeout settings checked against the 118s figure, a load test showing retry behavior stays bounded, or a documented waiver or revised budget for the 60s target.
